name: Vicious Offering — -2/-2 unkicked, -5/-5 instead when kicked
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py ('otherwise' / 'if kicked … instead' theme). 'Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn instead.' The kicked sentence produced nothing and there was no way to say a spell was kicked. Spells with such a sentence now carry additionalCostLabel ('Kicked') and a toggle (setAdditionalCostPaid); the replaced sentence applies only unpaid and the 'instead' sentence only paid, both at the one chosen target. Bears take the unkicked copy (0/0), Hill Giant the kicked one (-2/-2).
